common.tagline: Snap a product photo. Get a store listing in English and Bangla.

demo.banner: You're in a demo shop. Products go to our test store.
demo.cta: Sign in to use your own store
demo.expired: This demo shop has ended after 24 hours. Start a new demo or sign in with Google.

signIn.title: Sign in to your shop
signIn.sentBody: We sent a link to {email}. It works for 15 minutes.
signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to use ListSnap for products you're allowed to sell.
signIn.devMailNote: Development: the link is printed in the server console.
signIn.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
signIn.errorExpired: That link has expired. Send a new one.

landing.title: From one photo to a store-ready listing
landing.body: ListSnap finds the product in your photo, cuts it out, writes the listing in English and Bangla, makes studio photos and saves a draft to your WooCommerce store.
landing.steps: Photo → cutout → listing → studio photos → store draft

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.freeBody: 20 listings a day, 60 images. Nothing to pay during the beta.
pricing.proBody: Pay per listing, about the cost of a cup of tea. Coming later.

onboarding.title: Set up your shop
onboarding.body: Two quick steps: name your shop, then connect your WooCommerce store.
onboarding.errorName: Give your shop a name (2–80 characters).
onboarding.storeBody: ListSnap saves every listing to your store as a draft. Nothing is published without you.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Snap a product to make your next listing.
dashboard.empty: No listings yet. Your first one takes about a minute.
dashboard.listingsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No listings} one {# listing} other {# listings}}

snap.title: New listing
snap.intro: Take or upload up to 5 photos of one product. A plain background and good light work best.
snap.drop: Drop photos here, or paste from the clipboard
snap.selected: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} ready
snap.tooMany: Up to 5 photos of one product.
snap.notPhoto: That file isn't a photo. Use JPG, PNG or HEIC.
snap.uploadFailed: The upload didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
snap.tips: Fill the frame with the product, avoid shadows, one product per photo.
snap.recentEmpty: Your listings will show up here.
snap.sampleFailed: The sample photo didn’t load. Try again.
snap.several: {count} photos: how should they be listed?
snap.eachOwnHint: Different products, listed together in bulk
snap.sameProductHint: One listing with all the photos

job.title: Making your listing
job.failedHint: This step failed. Your other work is safe.
job.chooseBody: Pick the items to list and how to list them.
job.chooseConfirm: Continue with {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}
job.doneTitle: {count, plural, one {Your listing is ready} other {Your # listings are ready}}
job.doneBody: Check the text, then save it to your store. Products are always saved as drafts.
job.notFound: This job isn't in your shop.
job.offline: You're offline. The steps continue when you're back.
job.saveFailed: Your store didn’t answer. Your listing is safe here. Try again.
job.foundCaption: {count, plural, one {What SAM found} other {What SAM found: # items}}
job.compare: Compare your photo with the result

hints.too_small: The product fills only {fill}% of the photo. A closer shot gives better results.
hints.blurry: The photo looks blurry. Hold the phone still or tap to focus.
hints.too_dark: The photo is dark. Move to brighter light.
hints.too_bright: The photo is very bright. Avoid direct flash or sun.

placeholder.body: This page is part of the app shell. It gets built in {phase}.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Your work is saved. Try again, or go back to the dashboard.
errors.notFoundBody: This page doesn't exist or isn't in your shop.

done.title: Saved to your store
done.heading: {count, plural, one {Draft saved} other {# drafts saved}}
done.body: “{title}” is in your store as a draft.

connect.guide1: In WordPress, open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
connect.guide2: Click “Add key”, give it a name like ListSnap, and set Permissions to Read/Write.
connect.guide3: Click “Generate API key”, then copy the consumer key and secret here.
connect.retestHint: You changed the details. Test the connection again.
connect.defaultCategoryHint: Used when your store has no category that matches the product.
connect.createCategories: Let ListSnap create a matching category
connect.demoStore: No store yet? Use the demo store for now

errors.url: Enter your store’s web address, like https://myshop.com.
errors.keys: Paste both the consumer key and the consumer secret.
errors.demo: Demo shops always use our test store.
errors.failed: We couldn’t test the store just now. Try again in a moment.

https.warn: Not secure (HTTP). Fine for a test store only.
https.fail: Your store address must start with https://.

reach.fail: We couldn’t reach WooCommerce at this address.

read.fail: Your store didn’t accept these keys.

color.warn: No Color attribute yet. ListSnap adds colours as product details for now.

reasons.http: Use the https:// address of your store.
reasons.private: Use your store’s public web address.
reasons.unreachable: Check the address, and that your site is online.
reasons.not_woo: Check the address, and that WooCommerce is installed and active.
reasons.server: Your store had a problem. Try again in a moment.
reasons.keys: Copy the key and secret again from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
reasons.read_only: Your keys are Read-only. In WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API, set Permissions to Read/Write.

connections.demoShopBody: Demo shops save their drafts to our test store.
connections.usingDemoBody: You’re saving drafts to our test store for now. Connect your own store any time.
connections.disconnectHint: Drafts already in your store stay there.
connections.notConnected: Connect your store so ListSnap can save listings to it as drafts.
connections.instagramSoon: Coming soon. Posting from your own account needs Meta’s app review; demo shops use our test account.
